away.summary: The Red Wings (9-12-3) are projected to start John Gibson in goal, though Daniil Tarasov made 25 saves in a 5-1 win over Vancouver on Wednesday, so Gibson's start is not yet confirmed. Newly acquired forward Kirby Dach is expected to make his Red Wings debut after practicing on the third line between J.T. Compher and Michael Brandsegg-Nygard, while Sam Montembeault remains out with a lower-body injury and will have to wait longer for his debut. Jacob Bernard-Docker and Mason Appleton are listed as scratched.

out.detail: upper body injury, placed on Injured Reserve
upper body injury, left game after hit to the head

home.summary: The Blue Jackets (9-13-1) are projected to start Jet Greaves, who will make his first start in five games since Nov. 14; Cam Talbot is listed as the backup after making 24 saves in a 3-2 shootout loss to New Jersey on Wednesday. Sean Monahan returns after missing five games with an upper-body injury, while Erik Gudbranson replaces Denton Mateychuk on defense. Dmitri Voronkov is scratched.
